EXACTLY as written (case and whitespace matter); copy them from the records. Findings are matched
one-to-one against the hidden answer on type, affected_ids (as a set), amount within tolerance,
currency and a complete evidence set. Repeated findings count as false positives. A wrong value
only makes a finding unmatched; a malformed structure (wrong JSON types, missing fields, limits
exceeded) ends the episode with -1. Explanations are not scored.

Reward = clip(2*F1 - 1 - 0.002*inspection_steps, -1, 1), where inspection_steps counts every
step before submit (including invalid actions). Malformed findings end the episode with -1.
Limits: 100 steps including submit; 60 seconds; at most 30 findings,
10 evidence ids per finding, 1000 characters of explanation.

policy.accounting_date: The local calendar date, in the company timezone above, of the source document: invoice.issued_at for invoices, payment.timestamp for payments.

reporting_period.rule: A posting belongs to this period if and only if the accounting date of its source document falls between start and end inclusive. Ledger timestamps are stored in UTC.

fx.quote: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency (the base currency).
fx.rate_date: Use the rate dated on the document's accounting date.
fx.settlement: AP is cleared at the invoice's rate; Bank is credited at the payment's rate; the difference is posted to account 7900.

rounding.rule: convert(amount_minor) = round_half_up(amount_minor / 10**exp(source) * rate, exp(target)) expressed in target minor units. Each document amount (or remittance line) is converted once, as a whole.

posting_rules.invoice: Dr expense / Cr 2000 AP, base amount of the invoice total.
posting_rules.payment_with_remittance: One Dr 2000 AP row per remittance line (invoice_id set) at the invoice's rate; Cr 1000 Bank at the payment's rate; difference to 7900.
posting_rules.payment_without_remittance: Dr 2090 Suspense / Cr 1000 Bank at the payment's rate. This is correct treatment.
posting_rules.reversal: Mirror image of the original invoice rows; an invoice reversed in full has no net effect.

policy.allocation: Every remittance line (invoice_refs) of a payment must be applied in full to the referenced invoice's AP. Suspense is only for payments without remittance information.
policy.duplicates: A supplier invoice is identified by (entity_id, vendor_ref). It may be recorded at most once, net of reversals. Equal amounts or equal vendor_ref across different suppliers are not duplicates.

fields.doc_id: doc_id of an invoice or payment
